summary: Evidence packet for the runx crm-cleanup skill (automerchlab/crm-cleanup@2.1.1). The skill is a three-step graph: read the account's current CRM records and stream version from an append-only event log, reconcile a call transcript against those records, then execute only the fields that actually changed as a compare-and-set append that seals a before/after write result. A real post-publish dogfood run of the PUBLISHED package (registry_source=remote https://api.runx.ai) read back records written by an earlier run (budget=$40k, next_step=wait for procurement, status=contacted at version 1), decided 3 field update(s) (budget=$75k, next_step=send over a proposal by Friday, status=qualified), and committed them at version 1 -> 2 with event_ref crm_records:acct-northwind:2. A second run on the same stream with a nothing-to-update transcript produced changed=false and did not execute the write step at all - its receipt carries no write_updates step output. The receipt passes runx verify with a production signature. Transport disclosure: steps 1 and 3 are a bounded append-only event log bundled with the skill, NOT the runx data-store; the native data.* tools are unreachable from a registry-installed package (see transport_disclosure). source_url, X.yaml, SKILL.md and verification.json all resolve at a single source revision (commit a2b63d5bea99a390a08c4bfc4dd247c4517712fe); this evidence packet and the report are its direct child and describe that same revision.

observations.value: Steps 1 and 3 are a bounded append-only event log bundled with the skill (steps/read_records.mjs, steps/append_event.mjs), NOT the runx data-store, and nothing in this packet claims a governed data-store append. The skill was first built on the native data.* tools and passed the harness that way, but a registry-installed package cannot reach them: running the published package fails with "Imported tool 'data.read_projection' was not found in configured tool catalogs", and runx/data-store is not resolvable from the hosted registry either (registry skill not found: runx/data-store), so context_skills does not help. The bundled transport implements the same contract explicitly: compare-and-set on the version read in step 1, idempotent replay by key with refusal on a key reused with different content, and a sealed before_version/after_version, event_ref and sha256 event_digest.
observations.detail: Honest description of the transport, as the prior review required.
